name: UDataComponent
description: UDataComponent is a DataStore-module wrapper that prioritizing speed and security at once, derived from legacy, DataDeter. Where you can handle player's data in high-level or use it in low-level without leaving the module environtment. UDataComponent guarantees anti data-loss with WAL or Backup, also helping you with built-in security tools.
author: Raihan Naufal Azmi
